title: GTA 6 Age Ratings Reveal Drug Use, Nudity, and Sexual Fetishes
description: Official age ratings for GTA 6 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S have been published ahead of its Nov 19, 2026 release, revealing M and 18+ ratings with mature content descriptions.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Age Ratings Revealed: M and 18+ Classifications Highlight Mature Content

The launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 is truly becoming imminent. As the release date of 19th November 2026 rapidly approaches, the official age ratings for the highly anticipated PS5 and Xbox Series X|S title have officially been published, according to reports from gaming media outlet Push Square.

### Standard Mature Classifications for the Franchise

As expected by the gaming community and industry analysts alike, the game has secured an M for Mature rating in the United States, alongside an 18+ classification in the United Kingdom. These ratings cement the title's position firmly within the adult-oriented gaming space, aligning with the traditions of Rockstar Games' blockbuster franchise.

### Content Descriptions Highlight Explicit Elements

While the letter grades themselves come as little surprise, the content descriptions tied directly to these official age ratings provide the most fascinating details. According to the published data, the game's official descriptors explicitly highlight elements including drug use, nudity, and various sexual fetishes. These details offer a glimpse into the unfiltered, mature depiction of modern society that players can expect when they step back into the criminal underworld.

With the age ratings now finalized and published, the countdown to November 19, 2026, continues to heat up as fans look ahead to the next massive milestone in Rockstar's release schedule.

## Editor's Take

The release of the official age ratings and their corresponding content descriptions for GTA 6 is a standard yet thrilling reminder that the game's launch is drawing near. By retaining its unfiltered, mature themes including drug use and nudity, Rockstar Games is clearly signaling that it will not water down its satirical and realistic vision of the modern world. It sets the stage for a landmark release in late 2026.
